formats.key: borrow((address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) marketParams, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, address onBehalf, address receiver)
effects: Morpho sends `assets` of the loan token to `receiver` (Morpho.borrow: safeTransfer(receiver, assets)).
If `shares` is used instead, Morpho sends toAssetsDown(shares) of the loan token, a value computed from market storage.
`onBehalf` takes on borrow shares (debt) in the market given by marketParams; the signer must be onBehalf or authorized by onBehalf.
The call reverts unless onBehalf's position stays healthy at the market's LLTV.
formats.shown: Borrow N loan token (0 shares) for onBehalf to receiver, with the market params, both amount inputs, onBehalf and receiver shown as fields.

findings.title: borrow by shares shows '0 <token>' in the sentence and the share count as a raw integer
findings.evidence: descriptor borrow: interpolatedIntent "Borrow {#.assets} ({#.shares} shares) ..." and field "Shares (0 if assets)" format raw; Morpho.borrow: `else assets = shares.toAssetsDown(market[id].totalBorrowAssets, market[id].totalBorrowShares);`
findings.fix: Hide the unused input with a visible ifNotIn ["0"] rule on each amount field and drop the zero value from the sentence. Label shares as debt shares, not a token amount.

findings.title: borrow labels the debtor 'On Behalf', but this address carries the new debt
findings.evidence: Morpho.borrow: `position[id][onBehalf].borrowShares += shares.toUint128();` descriptor field label "On Behalf", sentence "... for {#.onBehalf} ..."
findings.fix: Rename the field to "Debt owner" and change the sentence to "Borrow {#.assets} as debt of {#.onBehalf} to {#.receiver}".

cases.notes: 59000 frxUSD arrives at the signer, which matches the screen. The '(0 shares)' text is noise.

formats.key: repay((address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) marketParams, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, address onBehalf, bytes data)
effects: Morpho pulls `assets` of the loan token from the signer (safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, this, assets)) and uses the signer's existing allowance.
If `shares` is used, Morpho pulls toAssetsUp(shares) of the loan token. That amount comes from market storage and is not in the calldata.
If `data` is not empty, Morpho calls onMorphoRepay on the signer's contract before the transfer.
formats.shown: Repay N loan token (0 shares) for onBehalf, with the market params, both amount inputs, onBehalf and the raw callback data.

findings.title: repay by shares shows '0 USDC' and a raw share count, so the amount paid is not readable
findings.evidence: case 9 screen: "Repay 0 USDC (29512345678901 shares) for 0xDad7..."; Morpho.repay: `else assets = shares.toAssetsUp(...); ... safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), assets);`
findings.fix: Hide the zero input with visible ifNotIn ["0"]. Label shares as "Debt shares to repay" so the signer does not read the payment as 0. The token amount comes from storage and cannot be shown.

findings.title: repay shows callback data as raw bytes
findings.evidence: Morpho.repay: `if (data.length > 0) IMorphoRepayCallback(msg.sender).onMorphoRepay(assets, data);` descriptor field "Data" format raw

findings.fix: Hide the zero input with visible ifNotIn ["0"] and remove "({#.shares} shares)" from the sentence.

formats.key: supplyCollateral((address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) marketParams, uint256 assets, address onBehalf, bytes data)
effects: Morpho pulls `assets` of the collateral token from the signer and uses the signer's allowance.
onBehalf's collateral in the market goes up by `assets`.
If `data` is not empty, Morpho calls onMorphoSupplyCollateral on the signer's contract before the transfer.

formats.key: withdraw((address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) marketParams, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, address onBehalf, address receiver)
effects: onBehalf's supply shares go down; the signer must be onBehalf or authorized by onBehalf.
Morpho sends `assets` of the loan token to `receiver`. When shares is used, it sends toAssetsDown(shares), a value computed from market storage.
formats.shown: Withdraw N loan token (S shares) for onBehalf to receiver, with the market params, both amount inputs, onBehalf and receiver.

findings.title: withdraw by shares says 'Withdraw 0 USDC' while the signer receives 500437.145758 USDC
findings.evidence: case 4 screen: "Withdraw 0 USDC (490064251891825428 shares) for 0xd758... to 0xd758..."; mined: USDC 500437145758 from Morpho to signer (in); Morpho.withdraw: `else assets = shares.toAssetsDown(...); safeTransfer(receiver, assets);`
findings.fix: Hide the zero input with visible ifNotIn ["0"] on both amount fields and keep the zero value out of the sentence. Label shares as "Supply shares to redeem".

findings.title: withdraw says 'for {onBehalf}', but onBehalf is the position that loses the funds
findings.evidence: Morpho.withdraw: `position[id][onBehalf].supplyShares -= shares;` descriptor sentence "Withdraw {#.assets} ({#.shares} shares) for {#.onBehalf} to {#.receiver}"
findings.fix: Change the sentence to "Withdraw {#.assets} from {#.onBehalf} to {#.receiver}" and rename the field to "From position of".

cases.notes: The signer receives 500437.145758 USDC. The screen shows '0 USDC' and a raw share count. The reader got the direction and asset right, but not the amount.

formats.key: withdrawCollateral((address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) marketParams, uint256 assets, address onBehalf, address receiver)
effects: onBehalf's collateral goes down by `assets`; the signer must be onBehalf or authorized by onBehalf.
Morpho sends `assets` of the collateral token to `receiver`.
The call reverts unless onBehalf stays healthy, so the remaining position moves closer to liquidation.
formats.shown: Withdraw N collateral token of collateral for onBehalf to receiver, with the market params, the amount, onBehalf and receiver.

findings.title: withdrawCollateral says 'for {onBehalf}', but onBehalf is the position whose collateral goes down
findings.evidence: Morpho.withdrawCollateral: `position[id][onBehalf].collateral -= assets.toUint128();` descriptor sentence "Withdraw {#.assets} of collateral for {#.onBehalf} to {#.receiver}"
findings.fix: Change the sentence to "Withdraw {#.assets} collateral from {#.onBehalf} to {#.receiver}".
